valuation.method: Bank: tangible book value per common share (TBVPS) projected to the 12-month target date (Nov 2027) x P/TBV. Q3 2026 TBVPS $101.59 (reported 2026-10-13), growing about 6% a year (Q3 TBVPS up 6% y/y) to about $108 in Nov 2027 in the base case. P/TBV uses the steady-state check P/TBV = (ROTCE - g)/(COE - g): base (12% - 5%)/(10.5% - 5%) = 1.27x, with ROTCE 12% at the midpoint of management's 11-13% near-term target and COE 10.5% as a modelling assumption. Diluted shares about 1.84bn are derived from Q3 net income $5.245bn / diluted EPS $2.85 (not from a filing cover). USD listing, no ADR conversion.

bear.driver: Credit cycle turns (card and CRE losses, Markets seasonal and stress trading losses), ROTCE falls to about 10% and buybacks slow so TBVPS grows only about 1.5%.
bear.assumption: TBVPS $103 at 0.9x P/TBV (ROTCE 10% against COE about 11%)

base.driver: Management path holds: 2026 ROTCE above 11%, rising toward the 11-13% near-term target, TBVPS compounding about 6% with buybacks (about $3bn a quarter) and the dividend ($0.67 a quarter).

bull.driver: Markets and fee strength, benign credit, ROTCE about 13.5-14% and Banamex deconsolidation (2027) accretive to CET1 lets buybacks run faster; the market pays for delivery of the 14-15% longer-term ROTCE goal.
bull.assumption: TBVPS $111 at 1.45x P/TBV (a discount to the 1.8x steady-state value at 14% ROTCE)

valuation.implied_by_close: The close of $124.01 is 1.22x Q3 TBVPS of $101.59 and 1.15x base-case Nov 2027 TBVPS of $108. Aggregator consensus of roughly $144-152 (undated mix, see analyst_notes) implies about 1.35x base TBVPS, or TBVPS of about $113 at a constant 1.27x.
valuation.sensitivity: 0.1x of P/TBV moves the base target by $10.80 (8.7 pp of price return); $1 of TBVPS moves it by about $1.27 (1.0 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Reported ROTCE against the 11-13% near-term target (base needs about 12% for 2027), together with TBVPS growth (base needs about 6% y/y) and the buyback pace against the $30bn programme.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings, expected in mid-January 2027 (date not verified; confirm on the Citi IR calendar).

analyst_notes: No named individual analyst call was verifiable from the sources reached: the RBC (target cut to $135 from $150, Outperform, 2026-10-14) and TD Cowen (cut to $148 from $150, Buy, 2026-10-14) items are firm-only in the sources opened, and UBS, Evercore, KBW and Morgan Stanley items conflict across aggregators, so coverage is labelled unavailable and no weighted target is computed. Firm-level targets after Q3 cluster at $135-165 (mostly trimmed by $2-15 on Q3 results), and the aggregator consensus of about $144-152 is above the $137 base case, so the gap is roughly 5-10% of price, equivalent to about 1.35x P/TBV or TBVPS of about $113 at the base multiple. Targets are concentrated in the bank's 12-month views, many of them stale (June-August 2026 entries) and mixed horizon. Analyst consensus is not reconciled to any single dated source.
